# Draft:Public Prosecutor's Office (Czech Republic)

The '''Public Prosecutor's Office''' is an independent body responsible for prosecuting criminal cases, protecting public interests, and ensuring the legality of legal proceedings. It operates under the authority of the Supreme Public Prosecutor's Office and has a hierarchical structure with multiple levels. The office is crucial in ensuring the rule of law and maintaining the independence of justice in the country. Public prosecutors represent the state in criminal matters, supervise law enforcement, and ensure that justice is served in a fair and legal manner.
Organization
It consists of:
*'''Supreme Public Prosecutor's Office''' (Nejvyšší státní zastupitelství, NSZ) – the highest-level prosecutorial authority overseeing the Czech Public Prosecutor's Office.
**'''High Public Prosecutor's Offices''' (Vrchní státní zastupitelství, VSZ) – supervising lower-level offices.
***Prague High Public Prosecutor's Office (Vrchní státní zastupitelství v Praze)
***Olomouc High Public Prosecutor's Office (Vrchní státní zastupitelství v Olomouci)
**'''Regional Public Prosecutor's Offices''' (Krajská státní zastupitelství, KSZ) – overseeing district offices within their region.
***Regional Public Prosecutor's Office in Prague
***Regional Public Prosecutor's Office in Ústí nad Labem
***Regional Public Prosecutor's Office in Plzeň
***Regional Public Prosecutor's Office in České Budějovice
***Regional Public Prosecutor's Office in Hradec Králové
***Regional Public Prosecutor's Office in Brno
***Regional Public Prosecutor's Office in Ostrava
**'''District Public Prosecutor's Offices''' (Okresní státní zastupitelství, OSZ) – handling cases at the local level.
***District Public Prosecutor's Office of Prague 1; District Public Prosecutor's Office of Prague 2; ***District Public Prosecutor's Office of Prague 3; District Public Prosecutor's Office of Prague 4; ***District Public Prosecutor's Office of Prague 5; District Public Prosecutor's Office of Prague 6; ***District Public Prosecutor's Office of Prague 7; District Public Prosecutor's Office of Prague 8; ***District Public Prosecutor's Office of Prague 9; District Public Prosecutor's Office of Prague 10
**District Public Prosecutor's Office of České Budějovice (District Office of Jindřichův Hradec; District Office of Tábor; District Office of Písek; District Office of Strakonice; District Office of Prachatice)
**District Public Prosecutor's Office of Plzeň (District Office of Klatovy; District Office of Rokycany; District Office of Tachov; District Office of Domažlice)
**District Public Prosecutor's Office of Brno (District Office of Znojmo; District Office of Břeclav; District Office of Hodonín; District Office of Blansko)
**District Public Prosecutor's Office of Ostrava (District Office of Frýdek-Místek; District Office of Karviná; District Office of Nový Jičín; District Office of Opava)
